sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: Between two statements in F♯ minor

sections.label: Subject in F♯ minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times). Alto: a figure from the subject (4 times). Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a fifth every two bars. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a fifth every two bars.
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to B minor; perfect cadence in E major at bar 37; perfect cadence in D major at bar 41

sections.label: Subject in B minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From B minor to D major

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From D major to F♯ minor

sections.label: Subject in F♯ minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every two bars. Tenor: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a third every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a third every two bars.
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to B minor

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From B minor to E minor; perfect cadence in E minor at bar 107

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint. Returns in Episode 9 (bars 132–159).
sections.leads: From E minor to B minor

sections.label: Episode 8
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times). Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From B minor to E minor; perfect cadence in B minor at bar 120

sections.label: Episode 9
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 7 (bars 112–113) in part, with the alto's line in the tenor, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (4 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject and the opening of countersubject 1. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From E minor to F♯ minor

sections.label: Episode 10
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and the opening of the subject. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: the opening of the subject and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted.
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in F♯ major at bar 166; perfect cadence in B minor at bar 186
